slides.h: We opened our clinic in a week. Some of it was rushed.
Our first booking system was one of those rushed decisions.
body: We chose it quickly to get the doors open. It couldn’t do the one thing I cared about most.
If you’re busy, you want control over your own bookings. Not ringing a clinic and waiting an hour for someone to call you back.

slides.h: So we replaced it with Momence.
body: Now people book their own appointments, when it suits them, without waiting on us.

slides.h:
If I opened again, booking would be the first decision,
not one we rushed.
People ask which of us is in charge.

body: Fernanda leads clinically. I look after operations and the commercial side.

slides.h: Fernanda decided there are some higher-risk areas she won’t treat.
body: We get plenty of enquiries for them. Commercially, that’s not nothing.
I trust her clinical judgement. On clinical calls, that’s the end of the conversation.
